c22_implication.statement: C21 supplies structural explanation only. Any C22 work requires a separate prospective contract; no horizon, model, state architecture, or policy is selected here.

causal_adjustment_definition.current_return_from_entry: current C20 executable open at t / frozen entry price - 1
causal_adjustment_definition.method: within-trade fixed-effects weighted OLS / Frisch-Waugh residualization

DELTA_LIQ_15.materiality_rule: sign change or >=25% change in residual-covariance magnitude; descriptive implementation rule, not a predictive gate

correlations.statement: Average per-trade correlation is not the within-trade covariance component and cannot be averaged to reconstruct pooled correlation. Covariance decomposes additively under common centering; correlations use different variance normalizations.

covariance_identity.between: population covariance over equally weighted trade means
covariance_identity.within_mean: arithmetic mean over each trade's eligible snapshots

diagnostic_trade_means.prohibition: pbar_i and Vbar_i use full observed trajectories and must never be predictors or production features.

limitations: observed association, not an exit advantage, causal effect, policy profitability, or deployable predictive value
symbol cells may have limited trade support
